title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Termly Exam #1 (Term 1)

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #1 (TERM 1)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does the verse "Iyyaka na'budu wa iyyaka nasta'in" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Read in the name of your Lord
   B. You alone we worship and You alone we ask for help
   C. Say: Allah is One
   D. Allah is the Most Great

2. Which surah speaks about Abu Lahab? (1 mark)
   A. An-Nasr
   B. Al-Fatiha
   C. Al-Falaq
   D. Al-Masad

3. What does it mean to "emulate" the Prophet? (1 mark)
   A. Copy his good example
   B. Argue with him
   C. Fear him
   D. Forget his words

4. Which is an example of copying the Prophet's kindness? (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to greet people
   B. Sharing your lunch with a classmate
   C. Teasing a friend
   D. Hiding a friend's book

5. Why did people leave their valuables with Muhammad (S.A.W.) before Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Because they trusted him
   B. Because he was afraid
   C. Because he lived in the mountain
   D. Because he was the richest

6. What is the meaning of "adab of eating"? (1 mark)
   A. A prayer
   B. A fast
   C. A type of food
   D. The etiquette or good manners of eating

7. What is the best way to avoid wasting food? (1 mark)
   A. Feed it to no one
   B. Take a very large plate
   C. Refuse to eat
   D. Take only what you can finish

8. Brushing teeth can become an act of worship when you (1 mark)
   A. Do it without thinking
   B. Intend to follow the Sunnah and stay clean for prayer
   C. Do it while angry
   D. Do it to show off

9. What is a siwak? (1 mark)
   A. A small stick used to clean the teeth
   B. A prayer mat
   C. A water pot
   D. A type of cloth

10. Why is it good to have fresh breath when praying and meeting people? (1 mark)
   A. It is not important
   B. It makes prayer shorter
   C. It is respectful to Allah and to others
   D. It makes us tall

11. Which of these should you NOT do? (1 mark)
   A. Share your toothbrush
   B. Rinse your brush
   C. Replace an old brush
   D. Store the brush clean

12. Which of these is a value from sports? (1 mark)
   A. Boasting
   B. Cheating
   C. Anger
   D. Humility in winning

13. Which of these is an Islamic etiquette in sport? (1 mark)
   A. No insults or fighting
   B. Skipping prayer
   C. Bad words
   D. Betting

14. What should a boy cover at least while playing sports? (1 mark)
   A. Nothing
   B. Only the head
   C. From the navel to the knees
   D. Only the hands

15. Which name of Allah is in every "Bismillah" along with Ar-Rahim? (1 mark)
   A. As-Salam
   B. Al-Basir
   C. Ar-Rahman
   D. Al-Malik

16. According to the hadith, how many names does Allah have that whoever learns and understands them is rewarded? (1 mark)
   A. Ninety-nine
   B. Twelve
   C. Forty
   D. Ten

17. Which angels do Muslims believe sit beside every person? (1 mark)
   A. Ten guards
   B. Four rain angels
   C. Two recording angels
   D. None

18. Belief in angels is one of the pillars of (1 mark)
   A. Hajj
   B. Islam only
   C. Iman
   D. Zakat

19. Who is the last prophet? (1 mark)
   A. Yahya
   B. Isa
   C. Sulaiman
   D. Muhammad (S.A.W.)

20. Which two prophets showed obedience when Ibrahim was told in a dream to sacrifice? (1 mark)
   A. Yusuf and Yaqub
   B. Nuh and Hud
   C. Ibrahim and Ismail
   D. Musa and Harun

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Give three character traits of the Prophet (S.A.W.) and one way to practise each. (3 marks)

22. Explain, using one of the angels, how angels' duties help us in our lives. (5 marks)

23. Write any ten prophets mentioned in the Qur'an. (5 marks)

24. Give the meanings of As-Salam, As-Sami' and Al-Basir. (3 marks)

25. How did Prophet Ibrahim (A.S.) show generosity? (3 marks)

26. List the steps of brushing teeth correctly. (3 marks)

27. Explain the message of the last verse of Surah Al-Kafirun. (3 marks)

28. State three times when the siwak or toothbrush is recommended. (3 marks)

29. Write the hadith on brushing teeth given in your syllabus. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #1 (TERM 1) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — You alone we worship and You alone we ask for help
   This is the fifth verse of Al-Fatiha.

2. D — Al-Masad
   Al-Masad warns Abu Lahab, whose wealth did not save him.

3. A — Copy his good example
   To emulate is to follow an example.

4. B — Sharing your lunch with a classmate
   Kindness means caring for others.

5. A — Because they trusted him
   He was called Al-Amin.

6. D — The etiquette or good manners of eating
   Adab means manners.

7. D — Take only what you can finish
   Small portions can be repeated if needed.

8. B — Intend to follow the Sunnah and stay clean for prayer
   Good intention makes daily acts worship.

9. A — A small stick used to clean the teeth
   The siwak comes from the arak tree.

10. C — It is respectful to Allah and to others
   A clean mouth shows respect.

11. A — Share your toothbrush
   Sharing a toothbrush spreads germs.

12. D — Humility in winning
   A Muslim thanks Allah and stays humble.

13. A — No insults or fighting
   A Muslim keeps good manners on the field.

14. C — From the navel to the knees
   This is the minimum covering.

15. C — Ar-Rahman
   Bismillah ir-Rahman ir-Rahim contains both names.

16. A — Ninety-nine
   The hadith speaks of ninety-nine names.

17. C — Two recording angels
   The Qur'an (50:17-18) mentions two.

18. C — Iman
   The six pillars of Iman include angels.

19. D — Muhammad (S.A.W.)
   Qur'an 33:40 calls him Seal of the Prophets.

20. C — Ibrahim and Ismail
   Both were ready to obey Allah.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: Trustworthy: return borrowed items. Truthful: tell the truth about mistakes. Kind: share your lunch.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each trait with a suitable way.

22. (5 marks)
   Answer: Jibril brought the Qur'an that guides us; Mikail's duty of rain helps crops; Raqib and Atid keep record so we can be rewarded; Malakul Maut reminds us to prepare; Israfil reminds us of the Day of Judgement.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the name, 1 mark for the duty, 1 mark for the benefit, 2 marks for a clear explanation.

23. (5 marks)
   Answer: Any ten of Adam, Idris, Nuh, Hud, Salih, Ibrahim, Lut, Ismail, Ishaq, Yaqub, Yusuf, Ayyub, Shuayb, Musa, Harun, Dhul-Kifl, Dawud, Sulaiman, Ilyas, Al-Yasa, Yunus, Zakariyya, Yahya, Isa, Muhammad.
   Working / marking points: Half a mark for each name up to 5 marks.

24. (3 marks)
   Answer: As-Salam: the Source of Peace; As-Sami': the All-Hearing; Al-Basir: the All-Seeing.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: When guests came, he quickly brought a fattened calf to serve them and welcomed them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for guests, 1 mark for the food, 1 mark for welcome.

26. (3 marks)
   Answer: Say Bismillah, use a pea-sized amount of paste, brush outer, inner and chewing surfaces, brush the tongue, rinse and store the brush.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct group of steps up to 3.

27. (3 marks)
   Answer: "For you is your religion and for me is mine." A Muslim stays firm in his faith and respects the right of others to hold their beliefs.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the meaning, 1 mark for firmness, 1 mark for respect.

28. (3 marks)
   Answer: Before wudhu and prayer, on waking up, when the mouth smells, before sleeping.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct time.

29. (2 marks)
   Answer: Brushing of teeth is a means of purification of the mouth and pleases Allah.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for purification and 1 mark for pleasing Allah.
